title: Charitas Clew: Bureaucracy is heavy. Let's build the counterweight.
why_read: An LLM-based plain-language translator for bureaucratic notices, a reasonable applied-AI use case but largely a thin wrapper around existing language models.
analysis: Charitas Clew uses Google AI to translate dense legal/bureaucratic notices (utility shutoffs, eviction notices, etc.) into plain language with structured outputs like key dates and a speaking script for affected users. The social use case is genuinely valuable, but from an engineering standpoint it appears to be a prompt-engineering application on top of an LLM rather than a technically novel system. Interest is modest for readers focused on applied AI patterns for accessibility and civic tech.
